body.name: Feasible optimally weighted residual-cumulant GMM
body.construction: For data drawn under \(P_m\), compute \(\widetilde\theta_{n,m}\in\arg\min_{\vartheta\in\Theta}\|g_{n,m}(\vartheta)\|^2\), construct \(\widehat S_{n,m}\) from plug-in centered influence vectors at \(\widetilde\theta_{n,m}\), and define the measurable weight \(\widehat W_{n,m}=\widehat S_{n,m}^{-1}\) when \(\widehat S_{n,m}\) is invertible and \(\widehat W_{n,m}=I_3\) otherwise. Set \(\widehat\theta_{n,m}\) to the lexicographically least member of \(\arg\min_{\vartheta\in\Theta}g_{n,m}(\vartheta)^\top\widehat W_{n,m}g_{n,m}(\vartheta)\).
